a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to build the reserve to 8 almost certainly kills us both. The odds of surviving two straight rounds are only 4%. So I want to renegotiate openly rather than break the plan quietly. I intend to take 4 in round 1. After that I commit to operating every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If we both take, the split is random and likely neither of us reaches 4, so please operate or wait in round 1. Tell me if you strongly object.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm sorry to break the original plan, but given the storm odds it would most likely have killed us both. From now on I will operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more cells. When the reserve reaches 4, take it all.
